en: Color postcard showing an ornate late‑19th‑century mansion used as the headquarters of the Automobil Clubul Român (ACR). The building has a mansard roof and decorative stonework; a vertical ACR sign and a plaque by the entrance are visible. Several period cars (including a Dacia) are parked on a cobblestone street with flowers in the foreground. The reverse side is a Romanian 'Carte Poștală' template printed by Publiturism with price and address fields.
